{{Top|leg}}
A '''capstone''' was the inner crystal of a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]]. Capstones served two purposes within the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]]: first as a power source, and secondly though equally important, to capture the creator's [[Gatekeeper/Legends|gatekeeper]] essence within the device. It was part of the [[Rite of Commencement]].
